notes.title: Patch 1.02 Released
notes.content:
Gameplay
- Added 'Build' option. Click 'Build' on the title menu and start designing your own Rooms puzzle! Start by dragging in the Room tile from the right side menu and design your own puzzle!

Misc.
- Added a link to new sequel Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle on the title menu. 
Please support the new self-published sequel from HandMade Game on Steam Greenlight!

 Rooms: The Unsolvable Puzzle on Steam Greenlight

notes.title: Steam Trading Cards now available!
notes.content:
Steam Trading Cards for Rooms: The Main Building featuring artwork from the game!

Added Steam Trading Cards 
- A set of 6 trading cards are available. 
- Added 5 profile backgrounds. 
- Added 9 emoticons. 

Please look for more updates from Zero Rock and HandMade Game in the future!
